{
    "sla_rules": [
        {
            "rule_id": "RULE_001",
            "metric": "ErrorRatePercentage",
            "threshold": 1.0,
            "threshold_operator": ">=",
            "penalty_amount": 1000,
            "penalty_type": "monetary",
            "penalty_percentage": 10,
            "description": "10% penalty if error rate equals or exceeds 1% at any time",
            "applicable_period": "incident-wise"
        },
        {
            "rule_id": "RULE_002",
            "metric": "ResolutionTimeMinutes",
            "threshold": 120,
            "threshold_operator": ">",
            "penalty_amount": 500,
            "penalty_type": "monetary",
            "penalty_percentage": 5,
            "description": "5% penalty if resolution time is greater than 120 minutes",
            "applicable_period": "incident-wise"
        },
        {
            "rule_id": "RULE_003",
            "metric": "InitialResponseTimeMinutes",
            "threshold": 5,
            "threshold_operator": ">",
            "penalty_amount": 200,
            "penalty_type": "monetary",
            "penalty_percentage": 2,
            "description": "2% penalty if initial response time is greater than 5 minutes",
            "applicable_period": "incident-wise"
        }
    ],
    "violation_conditions": [
        {
            "metric": "ErrorRatePercentage",
            "condition": "ErrorRatePercentage >= 1.0",
            "penalty_rule": "10% penalty if error rate equals or exceeds 1% at any time"
        },
        {
            "metric": "ResolutionTimeMinutes",
            "condition": "ResolutionTimeMinutes > 120",
            "penalty_rule": "5% penalty if resolution time is greater than 120 minutes"
        },
        {
            "metric": "InitialResponseTimeMinutes",
            "condition": "InitialResponseTimeMinutes > 5",
            "penalty_rule": "2% penalty if initial response time is greater than 5 minutes"
        }
    ],
    "sql_query": "SELECT IncidentID, DetectedAt, CASE WHEN ErrorRatePercentage >= 1.0 THEN 1000 WHEN ResolutionTimeMinutes > 120 THEN 500 WHEN InitialResponseTimeMinutes > 5 THEN 200 ELSE 0 END AS TotalPenalty FROM incidents_api_service",
    "data_fields_required": ["IncidentID", "DetectedAt", "ErrorRatePercentage", "ResolutionTimeMinutes", "InitialResponseTimeMinutes"],
    "monthly_service_fee": 20000,
    "max_monthly_penalty_percentage": 20
}
